name: MiddleSum
description: MiddleSum is an evaluation benchmark designed to study context utilization and position bias in abstractive summarization with large language models. It focuses on how models handle dispersed crucial content throughout long source documents, addressing the tendency of models to favor initial and final input segments.
reputation: A niche benchmark used in recent long-context summarization research to probe position bias and context utilization, but not yet widely adopted as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on position bias in summarization and evaluates alternative inference methods like hierarchical and incremental summarization.
